name: Poison, Basic (vial)
description: A basic weapon poison applied to deliver harmful effects on the next successful hit.
narrative_effects: Coats a weapon to deliver a poison effect on the next successful strike.

mechanical_effect.trigger: applied to a weapon before the next successful strike; poison is delivered on that strike
mechanical_effect.modifier: poison effect on next successful strike
mechanical_effect.applies_to: the next successful weapon strike made with the coated weapon where the target can be poisoned
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: targets immune or not meaningfully susceptible to poison; attacks after the coating is spent; checks unrelated to delivering the coated strike
